summary: Fix the zoom anchor and smoothness. The old restore expression was identically target.offsetTop (within = prevTop - top cancels out), so zoom and 适宽 always jumped to the top of the page and the cursor correction measured from the wrong place. The restore now keeps the fraction of the page; cursor anchoring is measured against the gesture-start scroll position and the last rendered scale; and during a gesture the rendered pages are scaled with a CSS transform for instant feedback, with a crisp re-render on 180ms idle.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 7b80b60. Reader UI only; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: UI zoom arithmetic only; no model call, no operation or ceiling change.
budget_impact.before: Zoom and fit-width jumped to the page top; gestures re-rendered rather than scaled.
budget_impact.after: Fractional page restore, cursor-anchored accumulation, instant CSS scaling with idle crisp re-render.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; UI zoom fix, not recommendation quality

open_risks: A real trackpad pinch still cannot be performed here, so the feel is unverified.
During a gesture the bitmap is CSS-scaled and slightly soft until the idle re-render.
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
